example:
A new function `helper` has no reference, and no evidence record has ever read
it. `habeas status` warns about it at once; nothing in any window names it.
{test}`requirements.references.coverage.report`
rationale:
The example is covered by a `{test}` reference on `tests/coverage.rs#fn[coverage_lasts_for_three_reauthorings_of_the_record_that_read_an_item]`.

**Setup.** `project()` writes a `src/lib.rs` where `fn helper() {}` has no reference. The test then records `rules.check` as reading only `fn[parse]` and `rules.render` as reading only `fn[render]`. No record ever reads `helper`.

**Assertions.**
- Right after the first commit, `assert_eq!(warned(root), ["helper"])` shows `helper` is warned about at once. `parse` and `render` are covered, and `fixture` in `mod tests` is excluded.
- Two more re-authorings follow. After each, the loop asserts `warned(root) == ["helper"]`. After the third, the assertion is `["parse", "helper"]`. This shows nothing in any window names `helper`, and `helper` is warned about throughout.
- `habeas::validate_repository(root)` is checked to produce no error mentioning `parse`, so the warning does not fail validation.

**Gap check.** The test calls `habeas::coverage_warnings`, not the `habeas status` command. `src/commands.rs#fn[status_markdown_with_github]` gets its warnings from `inspected_coverage_warnings`, the same function `coverage_warnings` uses, so the library call is what `habeas status` reports. A separate test, `status_shows_coverage_warnings_and_says_when_history_is_incomplete`, checks the rendered status text for `render`. I found no uncovered part of the example's scenario or expected outcomes.

text: A new function `helper` has no reference, and no evidence record has ever read
it. `habeas status` warns about it at once; nothing in any window names it.
`habeas status`, and `habeas author` after it finishes, MUST warn about every
and name, except items inside a module named `tests`. A warning MUST NOT fail
validation, and repository validation MUST NOT read Git history.
